title: PathBridger: Subgoal Bridges for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) aims to learn policies for reaching diverse goals entirely from fixed trajectory data. Long-horizon offline GCRL remains challenging because sparse goal-reaching signals must be propagated over many steps, while execution errors cannot be corrected through additional environment interaction. Existing methods address these challenges by improving long-range value estimation or reducing the effective decision horizon through subgoals, options, and action chunks. In several hierarchical methods, however, a selected subgoal specifies where to go, while the intervening state-space path remains implicit in an endpoint-conditioned low-level policy. To address this interface, we propose PathBridger, a hierarchical offline GCRL method that explicitly connects subgoal selection to short-horizon execution. translated_title: PathBridger：面向离线目标条件强化学习的子目标桥梁
translated_abstract: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）旨在完全从固定的轨迹数据中学习到达多样化目标的策略。长时程离线GCRL仍然具有挑战性，因为稀疏的到达目标信号必须在许多步骤中传播，而执行错误无法通过额外的环境交互来纠正。现有方法通过改进长程价值估计，或通过子目标、选项和动作块来缩短有效决策时域，以应对这些挑战。然而，在若干分层方法中，所选的子目标仅指定了要去哪里，而中间的状态空间路径仍然隐含在以端点为条件的底层策略之中。为了解决这一接口问题，我们提出了PathBridger，这是一种将子目标选择与短时程执行显式连接起来的分层离线GCRL方法。PathBridger构建一个通向所选中间端点的状态空间桥梁，并且……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出PathBridger，一种分层离线目标条件强化学习方法，通过构建通向所选子目标的状态空间桥梁，将子目标选择与短时程执行显式连接，从而应对长时程离线GCRL中稀疏信号传播与执行误差累积的挑战。
en_tdlr: PathBridger is a hierarchical offline GCRL method that explicitly bridges subgoal selection to short-horizon execution by constructing state-space bridges toward selected intermediate endpoints, tackling the challenges of sparse signal propagation and uncorrectable execution errors in long-horizon offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning.
